title: Teleport Tools
description: This is a mod I made in about 30 minutes, with the aim to create a Fabric-specific mod for use with Iris that adds teleport utility items for stress testing my new computer.
body:
Welcome to the Teleport Tools mod, AKA Telesticks.

This is a mod I made in about 30 minutes, with the aim to create a Fabric-specific mod for use with Iris that adds teleport utility items for stress testing my new computer.



It doesn't add much. There's a few "Telesticks", which when held in hand and right-clicked, you find yourself hundreds of blocks away.

-Red Telestick (Teleports you 300 blocks in the positive Z direction)

-Blue Telestick (Teleports you 300 blocks in the positive Z direction)

-Green Telestick (Teleports you 50 blocks up)

-Reverse Red Telestick (Teleports you 300 blocks in the negative Z direction)

-Reverse Blue Telestick (Teleports you 300 blocks in the negative Z direction)

-Reverse Green Telestick (Teleports you 50 blocks down)



Here's a mod showcase video I made: https://youtu.be/DqHeyG3IibA



Oh, and one more thing: You MUST have TP command priviliges in whatever server or world you're playing in for the basic teleport tools to work.
